name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S293 gave the production edge incident a measurable duration and published it. An append-only semantic ledger records only route-meaning changes and measures incidents against the last observation, so the live 0/5 route mismatch now reads as 13.3 days open, bounded by the independent uptime ledger and labelled as an upper bound rather than a claimed onset. The evidence graph gained human and agent projections plus three structural gates: declared checks must actually execute, a derived feed cannot ship without its ledger, and the /status/ renderer may only read fields its feed publishes. Production remains held and untouched.
publicNote: The status page can now report its own degradation: it shows the open edge incident, how long it has been running, and which feed proves it. Durations are stated as observation-bounded upper bounds, never as claimed start times.
nextMilestone: Restore Supabase SQL/Function authority and complete the real-provider identity ceremony, then rerun the release gate and restore/promote the production Worker only on all-green evidence — and verify the incident-close path against that real recovery.
blockers: The Supabase authority receipt is 1/4 ready: REST is HTTP 200, while management API, SQL migration, and Edge Function authority need an approved token or database/function credential through the secrets gateway.

The archive migration and Eternal Intelligence update are not deployed; authenticated Archive/Eternal tests and a real-provider Obelisk callback/session/member/investor/revocation journey must pass before production promotion.

Production CONTENT deploys are not landing (found S293, separate from the Worker hold): live /api/build-sha.json serves 4a72961d from 2026-07-24, 134 commits and 2.3 days behind origin/main, while Cloudflare Pages Deploy and Cache Purge report success on every push. npm run verify:deploy-parity is red on four missing live shell assets. Now measured every 30 minutes by api/deploy-currency.json; the deploy path itself is diagnosed but unrepaired.

Production Worker /v/rum has been stale since the 2026-07-03 out-of-band clobber, so RUM telemetry ingest is dark (last data 2026-07-02). As of S293 the degradation is measured, not just asserted: all 5 expected route contracts have been unmatched for at least 13.3 days (onset no later than 2026-07-12T23:52:39Z, corroborated by data/uptime-history.ndjson), and it is published on /status/. The canonical redeploy (gh workflow run cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml -f confirm_production=true) is founder-gated behind the fail-closed production promotion hold — restore requires clearing or explicitly accepting that hold.
